name: ComPatch Grey's + addon-VC
short_description: grey_usu's own redesign of popneed_leisure carries an air_travel entry commented out, with a note that Morgenroete's own contribution should still apply -- it doesn't, because grey_usu's REPLACE: wipes it, and the author's own follow-up fix only restores a different good. The other three pop_needs addon-VC carries (heating, luxury_food, free_movement) and four companies are confirmed non-issues, see README. Load after the whole Grey's pack.
